mentions.name: Book Reading Habit
mentions.description: An iOS reading app centered on habit formation for reading more consistently. It makes reading easy to start with short 5–10 minute sessions, picks up where the reader left off, and minimizes friction. Features include notes, progress tracking, session extension, shelves, and simple organization, deliberately kept quiet with no ads, no feed, and no clutter. Currently available on iOS only, with a possible Android release in the future.
mentions.problem: Built it because the author wanted to read more, but most reading apps feel too passive or turn everything into social noise.
